shortDescription: India's cabinet approved raising the wage ceiling for Employees' Provident Fund coverage to 25,000 rupees ($260) from 15,000 rupees on Wednesday, Information Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw said.($1 = 95.9700 Indian rupees)
